service.description: New voter registration (Form 6) on the Voters' Service Portal. After BLO verification the voter ID card (EPIC) comes by post.
service.depending: Passport size photo, age proof (birth certificate, school leaving certificate or Aadhaar), address proof, mobile number, voter ID number of a family member (if any)
service.rules: The applicant must be 18 years or older. A person can be registered at only one place. Give the reference number to the customer.
